name: DocTrackr

hero.headline: Document compliance, without the chaos.
hero.subheadline: Track expiring documents for every student and employee — and stay ahead of renewals automatically.

subtitle: Document expiry tracking system for a US-based daycare business.
problem: Documents tracked manually across spreadsheets and email. Expiry dates were missed, staff compliance was hard to monitor, and follow-ups were time-consuming for the owner.
solution: Custom dashboard with a full document database, per-employee and per-student document status, automated SMS and email reminders before expiry, and an admin-friendly interface the owner can manage without technical help.

features.title: Automated Reminders
features.desc: Email and SMS alerts before documents expire — no manual follow-up needed.

features.title: Document Tracking
features.desc: Expiry dates, reminder history, and document status for every person on file.

features.title: Status Dashboard
features.desc: Overdue, missing, expiring, and active documents visible at a glance.

features.title: Compliance Reports
features.desc: Full audit trail and status views for students and employees.

outcomes: Less manual tracking — the system monitors expiry dates automatically
Better compliance visibility across all students and employees
Reduced missed renewals with automated advance reminders
Owner saves hours every week previously spent on manual follow-ups
